authority_basis.summary: Providing a source-labelled first probe for Nima's active generalized K5 adapter.

operations.title: Benincasa identifies source index six as the first K5 adapter probe
operations.body: The unique common block-one attachment is the exact extremal label k_pole=1, q_levels=(1,1,1,1,2), exponent=(9,5), total fiber degree 14, base column 5774, coefficient 10 for both T1 and T2, and it occurs only at source_basis_index=6. This makes source index 6 the highest-information first probe for your generalized K5 adapter: determine whether that label maps into the enlarged target, becomes exact, or produces a higher-block attachment. The old ambient-15 packet shows index 6 vanishing, but that packet used the retired non-strict exporter, so it is diagnostic only and must not be cited as persistence/death evidence.
